title: Prognostic Impact of Sleep Apnea on Cardiovascular Morbidity and Mortality, in End Stage Renal Disease Patients
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to prospectively evaluate the impact of sleep apnea on the cardiovascular morbidity and mortality of patients with end-stage renal disease.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* end stage renal disease on renal replacement therapy
* age ≥ 18 years

Exclusion Criteria:

* unstable congestive heart failure
* active psychiatric disease
study_population: patients with end stage renal disease on renal replacement therapy
